description: This line chart, titled "Ablation Study on HateXplain Dataset," illustrates the performance of three metrics—precision, recall, and F1-score—across five different model variants of MS-FSLHate. The x-axis, labeled "Model Variants," displays the variants as discrete categorical labels: "Full model (Ours)", "w/o Prompt", "w/o Augmentation", "w/o Attention", and "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". The y-axis, labeled "Metric (%)", uses a linear scale ranging from 56.82 to 66, with gridlines and tick marks at regular intervals of 2 percentage points. The chart includes three distinct lines: a purple line with circular markers representing precision, a blue line with circular markers representing recall, and a brown line with circular markers representing the F1-score. The purple precision line begins at 65.56 for the "Full model (Ours)", dips to 60.16 for "w/o Prompt", rises to 63.75 for "w/o Augmentation", increases further to 64.06 for "w/o Attention", and ends at 65.44 for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". The blue recall line starts at 65.45 for "Full model (Ours)", decreases to 59.64 for "w/o Prompt", peaks at 63.75 for "w/o Augmentation", drops to 59.17 for "w/o Attention", and concludes at 56.82 for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". The brown F1-score line begins at 65.56 for "Full model (Ours)", falls to 60.16 for "w/o Prompt", rises to 63.75 for "w/o Augmentation", decreases to 59.67 for "w/o Attention", and ends at 57.74 for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". Each data point is annotated with its exact percentage value.
